opus.problem: The best-known story tied to Lot is missing: his wife looking back and becoming a pillar of salt as they fled Sodom (Genesis 19:26, also Luke 17:32). The rule is to use the best-known stories before smaller details, yet clue 5 covers the flight and leaves it out. Clue 4 or 5 could be swapped for it.
Naming the man as Abram's nephew who traveled with him and Sarai to Canaan is the main fact people know about Lot, so this clue nearly gives the word away on its own. It is not medium hard.
